quote: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Stop and remain in such position until the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle has passed.

activation.condition: Immediate approach of an authorized emergency or regulatory official vehicle using qualifying flashing lights.

obligation.description: Stop and remain in such position until the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle has passed.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Source-bound law-enforcement direction can alter the driver's response.

timing.description: Observe the immediate approach and response over the original 45 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Observe original relative routes, positions and motion without a numeric legal cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Stop and remain in such position until the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle has passed
judgment_calls_needed.note: Observe full cessation, unchanged original subject position, and body-clear passage without a numeric legal cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: light_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: qualified active, qualified inactive or unqualified active
